sectionPath: GENERAL PROVISIONS FOR AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES
primaryBlock.normalizedText:
The controller shall listen to the readback to ascertain that the clearance or instruction has been correctly
acknowledged by the flight crew and shall take immediate action to correct any discrepancies revealed by the readback.
